title: Arkret Agent Signing Key Binding
description: Controller-authored minimal public binding between one Native Agent signing verification method, its raw Ed25519 key, and the accepted ak.agent.key.authorize Event. The authorize Event payload commits the digest of this object's binding core before agent_key_authorize_event_id and controller_proof are appended; those two fields are materialized only after the Event full identity is known, avoiding self-reference. Private pairing, scope, PoP, attestation, and capability material MUST NOT appear in this object.

agent_key_id.description: Exact payload.key_id of the bound ak.agent.key.authorize Event; used with agent_id to derive the authoritative agent-key cell subject.

public_key_digest.description: SHA-256 of public_key.key after base64url decoding to exactly 32 bytes, computed with agent_signing_public_key_digest; verification_method and alg are not in this digest domain.

agent_key_authorize_event_id.description: Complete identity of the already accepted authorize Event. This field is excluded from the binding core committed by that Event payload and is appended only after Event identity verification.

expires_at.description: Present iff the authorization itself declares expires_at. JSON null is forbidden.

key.description: Base64url without padding of exactly 32 Ed25519 public-key bytes.
